milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The sugar cane cluster is at spawn-relative (2,0,3) to (6,0,4). Target is set to (4,1,4) as the center of the cluster at eye-level height. Max distance is set to 8 (not 16) to ensure the player has actually moved toward the sugar cane rather than just looking at it from spawn. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the sugar cane.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The large ferns are placed at spawn-relative coordinates (7-10, 0, 4-7). Target is set to (9, 1, 6) as the approximate center of the fern cluster at eye-level. Max distance is 8 to require the player to have navigated past the sugar cane area and into the fern/tree zone. Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking toward the ferns.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The purple bed is inside the cabin at spawn-relative (13,0,7) foot and (14,0,7) head. Target is set to (13, 1, 7) at eye-level. Max distance is 5 to require the player to be at or inside the cabin doorway (doorway is at x=11, bed is at x=13-14). Facing tolerance of 60 degrees ensures the player is looking at the bed.
